thread:
alex: Anyone else seeing 403s on SAML logout after the KMS cert rotation this morning? A couple of customers reported sessions not invalidating; POST /sso/logout returns 403.

sre-bot: deploy:cert-rotate completed for alias/redwood-app at 1719923000 :white_check_mark:

maria: Can you paste the logout binding in SP metadata? 403 on logout usually means signature/decrypt failure or SameSite cookie issues.

alex: SP metadata shows: `<md:SingleLogoutService Binding=\"urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST\" Location=\"https://app.example.com/sso/logout\" />` — so it's HTTP-POST. Logs attached: `saml.logout: deny reason=decryption_failed kid=alias/redwood-app-new`

omar: If the kid in the envelope header changed during the rewrap, SP might still be posting with the old envelope header. Quick check: grep auth logs for `saml.*logout.*deny` — I usually run: `sudo journalctl -u auth-service | grep \"logout\" | tail -n 50`

emily: Saw similar in staging last week — KMS rewrap replaced envelope headers (new kid) and our logout code only tries current key alias for JWE unwrap. Suggest we accept fallback aliases for ~24h after rotation.

maria: Another angle — confirm the POST is actually hitting same domain (https vs http) and cookie path/SameSite. If cookie isn't sent the session lookup will fail and we might treat it as unauthorized. But your log indicates `decryption_failed` so likely KMS envelope mismatch.

alex: Repro steps I used: `curl -v -X POST \"https://app.example.com/sso/logout\" -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' --data 'SAMLResponse=<...>'` — response headers show `Set-Cookie: session=deleted; Path=/; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax` but body 403.

omar: Can we verify KMS audit logs for ReEncrypt/Decrypt calls around 1719923000-1719923400? Maybe the old key alias still exists but we removed the ability for the runtime to fetch it. `aws kms list-aliases --key-id ...` or internal key-manager audit should show rewrap events.

emily: Short-term mitigation: re-add previous alias mapping in key-manager so envelope kid resolves to a valid decrypt key. Medium-term: update logout handler to iterate through recent alias history when unwinding JWE. I'll open a PR for a small retry loop.

maria: If we re-add alias, coordinate with infra so we don't break rotation invariants. Also add an alert rule: if saml.logout deny rate > 0.5% in 10m post-rotation, send pgp to #incident.

alex: OK doing those steps now — re-adding alias mapping as a hotfix and asking infra to enable fallback. Opening incident ticket INC-2026 and assigning to @maria and @emily. Will post updates here. :thumbsup:

emily: I'll draft the PR and leave a feature-flag gated rollout. Also adding a unit that exercises two-alias unwrap path.

omar: After alias restore, can we run a smoke: hit logout for a repro account and confirm 200 + cookie cleared? If still 403, attach full auth log and saml dump.

alex: Sounds good. I'll run smoke in ~10m and report back. Thanks all.
